biome_object.name: Biome Object
biome_object.description: The biome as one object: a height field with a basin, water in the low, crystals on the dry ridge, mycelium on the pool's wet rim and running out to every tree, trees on the mid-moist slope, flowers in the wet meadow, creatures beside them, cover by moisture. Every living thing is the old biome's own builder reached through BiomePaintDispatcher; only the cells are chosen by ecology instead of by hand. Five numbers of DNA: seed, size, moisture, relief, wildness. Improved generation by generation by tools/biome_rsi.py (the lineage is in the code's CHANGELOG and ada_run/biome_rsi/lineage.jsonl).
dev_themes: the cell is chosen by moisture, not by hand
the network joins water to wood
interactions: walk the ground: the pool in the low, the crystals on the ridge, the meadow between
follow the mycelium from the water to the trees
the same five numbers grow the same world
